MERCHANT AGREEMENT — SCHEDULE B (COMMERCIAL TERMS)

Contract: CTR-0001
Version: 1
Seller: SLR-0001
Effective from: 2026-01-01

1. COMMISSION. The Platform shall retain a commission of thirty percent (30%) of the Net Order Value, being the amount charged to the customer less any promotional discount and less shipping charges.

2. SETTLEMENT. The Seller's share shall become payable only upon confirmation of delivery, and shall be settled no earlier than forty-eight (48) hours thereafter.

3. PROMOTIONS. Discounts under Platform-run campaigns shall be funded 100% by the Platform.

4. REFUNDS. Where a customer refund is issued, the Seller payout for that order shall first be reversed. Commission retained by the Platform is refundable on a pro-rata basis.

5. TAX. The Platform shall withhold tax at source at one percent (1%) of the commission amount.

6. DELIVERY. A delivery fee of Rs. 45.00 per confirmed delivery is payable to the assigned delivery partner.
notes: Baseline agreement — the clean, unambiguous case.

2. SETTLEMENT. The Seller's share shall become payable upon confirmation of delivery. No additional hold period applies.

3. PROMOTIONS. Discounts shall be funded 25% by the Platform and 75% by the Seller.

4. REFUNDS. The Seller payout for an order shall be reversed prior to any refund being issued to the customer. Commission retained by the Platform is non-refundable. Reversal shall be completed within 72 hours.

6. DELIVERY. No delivery partner fee applies to this agreement.
notes: HARD CASE: commission on GROSS (pre-discount) value, non-refundable commission, and a strict reversal-before-refund ordering rule. Three interacting clauses where the naive reading is wrong.
